comment: Site plan and section detail sheets do not show dimension lines extending from the outside conductor to the outermost edges of proposed buildings and building projections. Clearance verification is not provided in enlarged plan details or section views.
applicableAreas: All proposed buildings (Bldg 1-8) within clearance distance of overhead electric facilities; south boundary retaining walls adjacent to OHE line

comment: Retaining wall section exhibits do not show dimension annotations from the outer electric conductor to the outermost edge of the wall face. The wall design maximum height of 14 feet and section details do not reference or verify clearance from overhead electric facilities.
applicableAreas: South boundary retaining walls adjacent to existing overhead electric line (OHE)

comment: No registered surveyor survey data provided showing overhead electric pole locations, conductor elevations, or mid-span clearance measurements. Vertical clearances from proposed driveways, parking areas, and grades to overhead facilities cannot be verified from submitted plans.
applicableAreas: Areas beneath overhead electric line on south boundary where driveways, parking, and structures are proposed

comment: Landscape plan shows mitigation trees (identified as 'M' symbols) with canopy circles positioned directly overlapping the marked overhead electric (OHE) line. Proposed tree species (Cedar Elm, Live Oak, Mexican Redbud, Texas Mountain Laurel) are not verified as utility-compatible per ECM Appendix F or documented as meeting required clearance distances. No clearance dimensions or utility-compatible species notation provided for trees within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors.
applicableAreas: South boundary landscape area where mitigation trees are proposed directly on or adjacent to overhead electric line (OHE)

comment: Cover sheet and general notes do not include required note that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003.
applicableAreas: Entire site with adjacent overhead electric facilities on all boundaries

comment: No horizontal clearance dimensions shown between building faces and overhead electric conductors. No surveyed conductor locations or elevation data provided to verify that 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance is maintained.
applicableAreas: All proposed buildings (Bldg 1-8) within potential clearance distance of overhead electric facilities

comment: No clearance dimensions shown from proposed facilities to overhead electric conductors. Overhead conductor types are not labeled as primary, secondary, or neutral on site plans, and 15-foot radial clearance cannot be verified without surveyed conductor locations.
applicableAreas: All proposed buildings and facilities on site

comment: No clearance dimensions shown from buildings to overhead electric facilities in adjacent right-of-way. Clearance verification cannot be performed without surveyed conductor locations and elevation data.
applicableAreas: Buildings proposed adjacent to Valley View Road right-of-way where overhead electric facilities exist

comment: No building elevation sheets containing surveyed overhead conductor locations and elevations are provided. Clearance dimensions from finished floor elevations and building projections to overhead conductors cannot be verified.
applicableAreas: Buildings Bldg 1, 2, 3, 7, 8 proposed within potential clearance distance of overhead facilities

comment: No horizontal clearance dimensions shown from retaining wall face to overhead electric conductors. Without surveyed conductor locations, 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance cannot be verified.
applicableAreas: South boundary retaining walls adjacent to marked overhead electric line (OHE)

comment: No vertical clearance dimensions shown from driveway/parking finished grades to lowest point of overhead electric facilities. Mid-span survey data for overhead conductor sag not provided. Minimum 16-foot (parking without truck traffic) or 18-foot (with truck traffic) vertical clearance cannot be verified.
applicableAreas: Driveways and parking areas beneath or adjacent to overhead electric line (OHE) on south boundary

comment: Landscape plan shows mitigation trees positioned at or overlapping the marked overhead electric line. Proposed site features (trees, possibly other landscape elements) may be located within electric easement or beneath/over overhead distribution facilities. Clearance from outside conductor not verified. Surveyed conductor locations and tree planting coordinates needed to confirm whether features maintain required 7.5-foot clearance or violate prohibition on installation under/over distribution facilities.
applicableAreas: South boundary landscape areas, electric easement areas along east boundary

comment: Plant schedule lists tree species (Cedar Elm, Live Oak, Mexican Redbud, Texas Mountain Laurel) but does not indicate utility-compatible (UC) designation per ECM Appendix F. Cannot verify whether proposed trees are UC-designated or not. Applicant must cross-reference all species against ECM Appendix F UC column and confirm all trees within 15 feet of distribution conductor are utility-compatible.
applicableAreas: Overhead electric distribution line on southern boundary near proposed mitigation trees

comment: Plant schedule provides species names and minimum container heights (e.g., 16' HT minimum for nursery stock), but does not provide mature height at maturity for any species. Cannot determine which species are large trees (40+ feet per ECM Appendix F maturity classification). Applicant must provide mature height for each tree species and verify no large trees within 25 feet of distribution conductor.
applicableAreas: Overhead electric distribution line on southern boundary

comment: At least one mitigation tree (M) is positioned 5-8 feet from an existing overhead electric utility pole on the southern boundary, placing it within the prohibited 10-foot clearance zone. All trees must be positioned minimum 10 feet (lateral distance from trunk to pole) from utility poles. Relocate tree or provide documented Austin Energy written approval.
applicableAreas: Southern boundary southeast corner, near OHE utility pole

comment: Electrical transformer pads are shown on electrical plan (Sheet 21) and trees are shown on landscape plan (Sheet 31), but the landscape plan does not indicate underground electrical equipment locations or dimensioned clearances. Cannot verify that trees are minimum 10 feet from pad-mounted equipment or that no trees are positioned between equipment access doors and drivable surfaces. Applicant must show transformer pad locations on landscape plan with dimensioned clearances from proposed trees.
applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations throughout site

comment: Electrical pull boxes are shown on electrical plan but not indicated on landscape plan with distances to proposed trees. Cannot verify that trees are minimum 5 feet from underground electrical equipment. Applicant must show pull box and underground equipment locations on landscape plan with dimensioned clearances from all proposed trees.
applicableAreas: Pull box and underground electrical equipment locations

comment: Without documented locations and distances of underground electrical equipment relative to proposed trees, cannot verify root barrier requirements for trees within 20 feet of underground equipment. Root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment) must be detailed for any trees within 20 feet. Applicant must identify trees within 20 feet of underground equipment and specify root barrier details on landscape plan.
applicableAreas: Areas within 20 feet of underground electrical equipment

comment: Landscape plan shows tree locations using symbol designations (M, SY, PL, P) without species identification. Plant schedule on Sheet 35 lists species and quantities separately but does not cross-reference which species correspond to each symbol on the landscape plan. Reviewers cannot verify species identity, utility compatibility, or maturity height for specific tree locations. Applicant must either label trees on landscape plan with species names or add legend clearly linking each landscape symbol to specific species in plant schedule.
applicableAreas: Landscape plan tree symbols throughout site

comment: Landscape plan does not differentiate large trees (mature height 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F). Plant schedule provides species names but no mature height values. Cannot determine which, if any, proposed species mature to 40+ feet or whether such trees are positioned outside the 25-foot clearance zone from distribution conductors. Applicant must provide mature height for each tree species and use notation or symbol on landscape plan to identify all trees that mature to 40+ feet.
applicableAreas: Landscape plan where large trees (40+ feet) may be proposed near overhead electric facilities

comment: At least one tree is proposed within a prohibited clearance zone (less than 10 feet from utility pole), which violates the categorical prohibition for all tree types. Plans do not include documented written approval from Austin Energy authorizing this exception. Applicant must either relocate the tree to comply with minimum 10-foot clearance or provide executed written approval letter from Austin Energy explicitly authorizing the variance.
applicableAreas: Southern boundary southeast corner, mitigation tree within 10 feet of OHE pole

comment: Transformer pads are shown on Sheets 21 and 9 adjacent to building exterior walls (west of Bldg. 2, west of Bldg. 8, between Bldg. 4-5, between Bldg. 6-7), but no horizontal clearance dimensions are provided to verify minimum 5-foot separation from buildings.
applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations (5 pads on site)

comment: Retaining walls are shown on Sheets 38-39 and grading plan, and transformer pads are shown on Sheet 21, but clearance dimensions between retaining walls and transformer pads are not documented.
applicableAreas: Retaining wall areas (NW corner and perimeter locations)

comment: Fences (H.6) are shown on landscape plan and site perimeter. Transformer access door orientation and clearances from removable ventilated fences (5 feet for operator sides, 3 feet for other sides) are not documented.
applicableAreas: Fence areas adjacent to transformer locations

comment: Sidewalks are shown on the site plan and electrical plan sheets, but the minimum 2-foot clearance from back of sidewalk to transformer pad edge is not dimensionally verified.
applicableAreas: Sidewalk areas near transformer pads

comment: Transformer pads are shown on Sheet 21, but access door orientation and the minimum 10-foot clearance for hot-stick use area to open area or adjacent building/structure are not documented.
applicableAreas: All transformer pad hot-stick use areas (5 pads)

comment: One private fire hydrant is shown on Sheet 10 (Fire Protection Plan), but dimensional clearance from the hydrant to the nearest transformer pad is not documented.
applicableAreas: Fire hydrant area relative to transformer pads

comment: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) shows trees on site, but the specific distances from each tree to transformer pads are not documented, and utility-compatible species verification per ECM Appendix F is not provided.
applicableAreas: Landscape planting areas near transformer locations

comment: Landscape plan shows shrubs and groundcover (H.7 SOD areas), but clearance distances from transformer access doors (10 lateral feet minimum) and other sides (5 lateral feet minimum) are not documented.
applicableAreas: Landscape shrub and vegetation areas near transformers

comment: Tree locations are shown on landscape plan, but distances from trees to underground electric transformer locations are not documented, and root barrier specifications (4 feet deep, 5 feet from equipment) are not provided.
applicableAreas: Trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment

comment: Site provides 41 bicycle parking spaces per Sheet 22, but specific bike rack locations relative to transformer pads and the minimum 5-foot clearance are not documented.
applicableAreas: Bicycle parking areas near transformer pads

comment: Fire lanes are shown on Sheet 10, but the minimum 15-foot clearance from transformer pads to fire lanes is not dimensionally verified.
applicableAreas: Fire lanes adjacent to transformer pads

comment: Five transformer pads are shown on Sheet 21, but minimum 5-foot clearance distances between pads are not documented.
applicableAreas: Multiple transformer pad locations (5 pads on site)

comment: Water lines are shown on Sheet 19 (Utility Tap Plan) and electrical plan shows transformer locations, but minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance between water lines and transformer pads is not dimensionally verified.
applicableAreas: Water line routing relative to transformer pads

comment: Wastewater lines are shown on Sheet 19 and transformer locations on Sheet 21, but minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance between wastewater lines and transformer pads is not documented.
applicableAreas: Wastewater line routing relative to transformer pads

comment: Storm drain lines are shown on Sheet 12 and transformer locations on Sheet 21, but minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance between storm lines and transformer pads is not documented.
applicableAreas: Storm drain line routing relative to transformer pads

comment: Multiple underground utilities are shown on utility plans and transformer locations on Sheet 21, but minimum 12-inch horizontal and vertical clearance from other underground utilities (except gas, fuel, steam) is not dimensionally verified.
applicableAreas: Underground utility locations near transformer pads

comment: Transformer pad locations and underground utility paths are shown, but no analysis is provided to verify that transformer pads or AE underground facilities are not located over or under other utility lines.
applicableAreas: All transformer locations and underground utility paths

comment: Transformer pad locations are shown on Sheet 21 near buildings and parking areas, but cross-section drawings demonstrating vertical clearances in access paths with overhead structures or parking garages are not provided.
applicableAreas: Access paths to transformer pads with overhead structures

comment: Transformer pads are shown on site plan, but their exact positioning relative to property lines is not dimensionally documented to verify 100% location on private property.
applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations (5 pads)

comment: Multiple easements exist on site (wastewater 10', drainage 25', drainage 10', electric 5' per recorded plats), but no analysis is provided to verify transformer pads are not located in prohibited easements (drainage, water, sewer, or electric easements under overhead lines).
applicableAreas: Transformer locations relative to existing easements

comment: Transformer easements are not shown around any of the five transformer pads on the site plan, electrical plan, or plat. UCM § 1.10.3 requires transformer easements for Austin Energy accessibility and maintenance.
applicableAreas: All five transformer pad locations

comment: Electrical routing is shown on Sheet 21, but the path of electric service from each transformer to associated meters is not dimensionally verified as 100% on private property.
applicableAreas: Electrical routing from transformers to meters

comment: Transformer pad dimensions are not provided on any sheet for any of the five pads shown. No reference to Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets is provided. Exact pad dimensions matching AE Design specifications for the specified service type are required.
applicableAreas: All five transformer pad locations

comment: Transformer locations and parking areas are shown on site plan, but documentation of which transformer pads (if any) are within 4 feet of parking/vehicle routes and bollard specifications (4-inch minimum diameter galvanized metal posts per AE Design details) are not provided.
applicableAreas: Transformer pads within 4 feet of parking areas
